```{r}
#| output: asis
#| label: tbl-reconciliation-summary
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'sR$`tbl-reconciliation-summary`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

# NEOIPC-PERMANENT(dataset-format): see rename_legacy_antibiotic_table() in
# this report's _setup.qmd. A dataset serialized before neoipcr 0.0.0.9007,
# or calculated from a raw dataset written before it, carries no
# reconciliation summary, and one imported with the reconciliations switched
# off carries an empty one; the section says which. Without the first branch
# such a file would be described as built with the reconciliations switched
# off, when it predates them.
reconciliation_strings <- sR$`tbl-reconciliation-summary`
own_reconciliation <- benchmark_data$reconciliationSummary$own
ref_reconciliation <- benchmark_data$reconciliationSummary$ref
if (is.null(own_reconciliation)) {
  no_data_table(reconciliation_strings$not_recorded)
} else if (!has_reconciliation_summary(own_reconciliation)) {
  no_data_table(reconciliation_strings$not_reconciled)
} else {
  # The column groups carry the labels the report's other tables give the
  # two datasets.
  summaries <- list(own_reconciliation)
  names(summaries) <- sR$own_data_label
  if (has_reconciliation_summary(ref_reconciliation))
    summaries[[sR$reference_data]] <- ref_reconciliation
  tbl <- format_reconciliation_summary_table(summaries, sR)
  if (is.null(tbl))
    no_data_table(reconciliation_strings$no_reconciliations)
  else
    tbl
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
# A reference dataset without a summary of its own contributes no column
# group; the reader is told rather than left to wonder.
if ("ref" %in% benchmark_data$dataset_names &&
    has_reconciliation_summary(own_reconciliation) &&
    !has_reconciliation_summary(ref_reconciliation))
  cat("\n", reconciliation_strings$reference_not_available, "\n", sep = "")
```
